lead_headline: Six new restaurant leads over the weekend — Mendocino Farms hits Union Station, Paperboy debuts in West Highland, plus DiFranco's Westminster opening

restaurant.blurb: 6 new leads since Friday — Mendocino Farms opened its third Denver location in Union Station, Austin brunch darling Paperboy landed in West Highland, and DiFranco's launched its second outpost in Westminster. Closures: Dumplin' shuttered mid-April after 18 months, Mojo-99 Burgers closed in late April.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications for the eighteenth consecutive day as Colorado's liquor license blackout stretches into its third week with no state communication. The freeze since April 30's renewal surge continues — no new filings, no status updates, no database activity across any license class. System remains completely dark as officials maintain radio silence on timeline or cause. May on track to close with perfect zero across all metrics and zero departmental accountability.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions yesterday — Instagram restaurant post plus Reddit dating-advice citation — lifts the 7-day total to 48 across 14 sources, down 8% from last week's 52. Facebook and Denver Post tie at 11 mentions each (23% share apiece), followed by Instagram with 10. Weekend bounce from Friday's single-mention low still leaves the week trailing prior period as Google News RSS drives 92% of discoveries (44 of 48). Monthly tally now 201 with flat week-over-week trend.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +5 since Friday (6 new, 1 canceled) pushes MTD to +21 (+1.2/day) while 90-day net advances to +134. Weekend delivered solid acquisition with minimal churn after Thursday's +4 and Friday's +1. The 7-day window closes at +6 (23 new, 17 canceled) — matching last week's net despite cancellations tripling (17 vs 5) and acquisitions climbing 53% (23 vs 15). Recent pattern shows late-week strength: last four days averaged +2.8 net versus prior three-day stretch at −0.7, though elevated weekly churn (2.4/day) keeps the 7-day rate (+0.9/day) running 25% below MTD pace.
